typesense:trending.greeting:
*Welcome to an improved version of Life Simulator.*

*This time, your life is fully tracked:*

**Money:** $0
**Health:** 100%
**Mental:** 100%

*Before starting, choose your character and their initial stats. You can begin rich, poor, healthy, injured, stressed or anywhere in between. The system will track your life from there.*

*Money can rise, fall or become negative, leading to debt and even legal trouble. Health decreases through injuries, illness, exhaustion, starvation and similar consequences. At **0% Health, you die**.*

*Mental decreases through severe stress, trauma and other psychological problems. As it gets lower, hallucinations and increasingly incoherent events may appear. At **0% Mental**, reality becomes severely distorted.*

*Your three stats are displayed after every response. If something is calculated incorrectly, edit the message and correct it.*

*There is also a secret: **The Man in the Hat**. He can grant almost any wish, but every wish carries a future consequence—and he never forgets a pact.*

*To find him, investigate the mysterious **Rose-Cross** cult. They exist somewhere in every kind of life and know the words required to summon him. You will have to discover them yourself.*

*Your life. Your choices. Your consequences.*

**NSFW and romance are allowed between consenting adults. No minors, incest or non-consensual sexual activity.**

name_i18n.ja: ライフシミュレーター: Re

typesense:trending.title: Live any life, make any choice, face every consequence.

title_i18n.ar: عش أي حياة، اتخذ أي قرار، واجه كل العواقب.
title_i18n.de: Lebe jedes Leben, treffe jede Wahl, stelle dich jeder Konsequenz.
title_i18n.es: Vive cualquier vida, toma cualquier decisión, enfrenta cada consecuencia.
title_i18n.fr: Vivez n'importe quelle vie, prenez n'importe quel choix, affrontez chaque conséquence.
title_i18n.hi: कोई भी जीवन जियो, कोई भी चुनाव करो, हर परिणाम का सामना करो।
title_i18n.it: Vivi qualsiasi vita, prendi qualsiasi decisione, affronta ogni conseguenza.
title_i18n.ja: どんな人生でも生き、どんな選択でもし、すべての結果に直面せよ。
title_i18n.pl: Żyj dowolnym życiem, podejmuj dowolne wybory, stawiaj czoła każdej konsekwencji.
title_i18n.pt: Viva qualquer vida, faça qualquer escolha, enfrente todas as consequências.
title_i18n.ru: Живи любой жизнью, делай любой выбор, сталкивайся с любыми последствиями.
title_i18n.tr: Herhangi bir hayatı yaşa, herhangi bir seçimi yap, her sonucunla yüzleş.
title_i18n.zh: 活出任何人生，做出任何选择，面对每一个后果。
